title: The DClinPsy Application Season is Coming! Timeline & Tips!

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取除了用时间换金钱以外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家Marianne Trent博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的职业旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得Sophie提供的奖励，以及我额外提供的专属支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份Fortnum and Mason的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正寻求成为一名心理学家，那么让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to be nice.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客陪伴，你将走上成为优秀心理学家的道路。

sentences.en: The Aspiring Psychologist Podcast with Dr. Marianne Turner.
sentences.zh: 《有抱负的心理学家播客》，主持人Marianne Trent博士。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: If you are listening on the day of release, which is Monday the 29th of August 2022, and you're in the UK, then today is a bank holiday, so enjoy.
sentences.zh: 如果你是在发布当天，也就是2022年8月29日星期一收听，而且你身在英国，那么今天就是银行假日，好好享受吧。

sentences.en: Does that mean that you get to stay in bed for a bit longer?
sentences.zh: 这意味着你可以多睡一会儿吗？

sentences.en: Does that mean that you get to go and do something fun?
sentences.zh: 这意味着你可以去做些有趣的事情吗？

sentences.en: Probably not in the sun.
sentences.zh: 可能不是在阳光下。

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实是这样。

sentences.en: It has been very sunny lately, but today it has started pouring with rain.
sentences.zh: 最近天气一直很晴朗，但今天开始下大雨了。

sentences.en: So there may not be sun around on that day, but what does it mean for you when you get an extra bank holiday?
sentences.zh: 所以那天可能没有阳光，但多出一个银行假日对你来说意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: I remember when I was growing up and I used to really like shopping, my friend and I were like, what is the point in bank holidays?
sentences.zh: 我记得我小时候特别喜欢逛街，我和朋友当时就在想，银行假日到底有什么意义？

sentences.en: Because the shops at that time were not open.
sentences.zh: 因为那时候商店都不开门。

sentences.en: We were like, we don't get it.
sentences.zh: 我们当时想，我们真是不明白。

sentences.en: It's so boring.
sentences.zh: 太无聊了。

sentences.en: I can't wait for the bank holiday to be over.
sentences.zh: 我真希望银行假日快点结束。

sentences.en: And then once you start working, you're like, oh, okay, I get the point of the bank holidays now.
sentences.zh: 然后当你开始工作后，你就会想，哦，好吧，我现在明白银行假日的意义了。

sentences.en: I'm really sorry to all the bank holiday gods I didn't get the point of you before, because now it's about a bit of rest and recharge.
sentences.zh: 我真的很抱歉，各位银行假日之神，我以前没领会到你们的意义，因为现在对我来说，这意味着休息和充电。

sentences.en: You know, I think for me, they really came into their own before I had children and when I was working full time.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得对我而言，它们在我有孩子之前和全职工作时才真正发挥了作用。

sentences.en: Certainly when it's during the school holidays, you don't really feel the benefit.
sentences.zh: 当然，在学校假期期间，你并不会真正感受到它的好处。

sentences.en: Certainly I don't, because I would usually have a Monday and a Friday off during the school holidays anyway.
sentences.zh: 至少我不会，因为在学校假期里，我通常周一和周五本来就休息。

sentences.en: So it's just a day, an extra day with the kids, which I know is a really nice thing as well.
sentences.zh: 所以这只是多了一天和孩子们在一起的时间，我知道这也是一件非常美好的事情。

sentences.en: Okay, so if you are listening live or live-ish, then what you might well be aware of already is that we have the 1st of September on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 好了，如果你是在直播或接近直播时收听，那么你可能已经意识到9月1日即将来临。

sentences.en: And the 1st of September is a pretty key date for aspiring psychologists.
sentences.zh: 而9月1日对于有抱负的心理学家来说是一个非常关键的日期。

sentences.en: And in case you don't know, I'll tell you why.
sentences.zh: 如果你不知道原因，我会告诉你。

sentences.en: So for a long time now, the 1st of September has heralded the opening of the application process for the clearinghouse applications for aspiring trainee clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，9月1日标志着有抱负的临床心理学实习生申请清算所（Clearinghouse）流程的开始。

sentences.en: So the rough time frame is it opens for applications in September, on the 1st of September.
sentences.zh: 大致的时间框架是，申请在9月1日开放。

sentences.en: When I was applying, it was always open until the start of December.
sentences.zh: 我申请的时候，它一直开放到12月初。

sentences.en: But I know during the pandemic, they scaled it back and sort of made it, I thought, mid-November.
sentences.zh: 但我知道在疫情期间，他们缩短了时间，我记得是到了11月中旬。

sentences.en: They've made it a bit earlier.
sentences.zh: 他们提前了一些。

sentences.en: I think that was to give them more time to sort out the processes involved in interviews.
sentences.zh: 我想这是为了给他们更多时间来处理面试的相关流程。

sentences.en: So if you are applying, please do check what the deadlines are.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你正在申请，请务必查看截止日期。

sentences.en: I did just have a little look online to see if there was any insider info ahead of the 1st of September.
sentences.zh: 我刚才在网上查了一下，看看在9月1日之前有没有什么内部消息。

sentences.en: And actually, the Clearinghouse Leads website says that they're getting a brand new website
sentences.zh: 实际上，清算所领导网站（Clearinghouse Leads）说他们将拥有一个全新的网站，

sentences.en: from September and that you can't get the new website address until September.
sentences.zh: 从9月开始，而且在9月之前你无法获得新网站地址。

sentences.en: So my advice to you would be to give it a Google, Clearinghouse Leads.
sentences.zh: 所以我给你的建议是去谷歌搜索一下“Clearinghouse Leads”。

sentences.en: And I would definitely think there'll be a redirect of their website address on their current website.
sentences.zh: 我肯定他们会在当前网站上设置重定向。

sentences.en: So the address is in the show notes, but just loosely speaking, it's www.leads.ac.uk forward slash Charlie Hotel Papa Charlie Charlie Papa.
sentences.zh: 地址在节目说明里，但简单来说，是www.leads.ac.uk/chpccp。

sentences.en: And that should hopefully bring you roughly to the right area.
sentences.zh: 希望这能带你大致到达正确的区域。

sentences.en: But like I said, if you give it a Google, it should come up.
sentences.zh: 但正如我所说，如果你谷歌一下，应该就能找到。

sentences.en: And there might well be that new website address from September onwards.
sentences.zh: 从9月开始，可能确实会有那个新网站地址。

sentences.en: So I know we do have a pretty varied audience for this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们的播客听众非常多样化。

sentences.en: So we do, of course, have people who are wanting to apply to the doctorate in clinical psychology this year.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们有今年想申请临床心理学博士学位的人。

sentences.en: But we also have people who don't study psychology and probably won't ever study psychology, but
sentences.zh: 但我们也有不学习心理学，可能永远也不会学习心理学的人，但

sentences.en: just enjoy learning a bit more about mental health, mental health professionals and the nuts and bolts behind the scenes in creating and maintaining mental health services.
sentences.zh: 他们只是喜欢更多地了解心理健康、心理健康专业人士，以及创建和维护心理健康服务背后的具体细节。

sentences.en: So let me just go over a little bit about what the processes are and what this application is all about.
sentences.zh: 所以让我简单介绍一下这些流程以及这个申请到底是怎么回事。

sentences.en: So there are essential criteria for applying for the doctorate schemes, which as a broad brush approach are largely funded courses.
sentences.zh: 申请博士计划有基本标准，这些计划大体上是获得资助的课程。

sentences.en: So you get funded by the local health education authority and employed by a local employing truSt.
sentences.zh: 你由当地健康教育机构资助，并受雇于当地的雇佣信托机构。

sentences.en: That's certainly the case in England.
sentences.zh: 在英格兰确实如此。

sentences.en: And I know that Scotland also offers funded places, as do Wales, but they aren't funded by health education England because they are not in England.
sentences.zh: 我知道苏格兰和威尔士也提供资助名额，但它们不是由英格兰健康教育局资助的，因为它们不在英格兰。

sentences.en: If you're wanting to apply and you don't live in England, there are options in other United
sentences.zh: 如果你想申请但不住在英格兰，英国其他国家也有选择，

sentences.en: Kingdom countries and there are also some self-funded places available too for some of the courses in England.
sentences.zh: 而且英格兰的一些课程也提供自费名额。

sentences.en: But the details of the amounts as of last year are in the Clinical Psychologist Collective book and it is quite expensive.
sentences.zh: 但去年的金额详情在《临床心理学家集体》一书中，费用相当昂贵。

sentences.en: I think from memory it's about 30 grand a year.
sentences.zh: 我记得大约是每年3万英镑。

sentences.en: Plus, of course, you'd need to be able to have some way to sustain yourself to be able to pay for your rent and your living fees as well, food and travel and all of that.
sentences.zh: 当然，你还需要有能力维持自己的生活，支付房租、生活费、食物、交通等等。

sentences.en: So it's not a small expense if you're looking to self-fund that, but some organisations do fund that for their employees as well.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你打算自费，这可不是一笔小数目，但有些机构也会为员工提供资助。

sentences.en: So it's not always people coming from different countries to do self-funding.
sentences.zh: 所以并不总是来自不同国家的人来做自费项目。

sentences.en: It is possible to be self-funded via companies sponsoring you to do that as well, which is worth bearing in mind.
sentences.zh: 通过公司赞助来获得资助也是可能的，这一点值得记住。

sentences.en: So in the most part, people will have a right to work in the UK and may well be British citizens
sentences.zh: 所以大多数情况下，人们在英国拥有工作权，很可能已经是英国公民，

sentences.en: already and will be applying for training for the doctoral schemes to be funded by the
sentences.zh: 并且会申请由英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）资助的博士培训计划。

sentences.en: NHS.
sentences.zh: 所以我将在本播客中以此作为主要建议。

sentences.en: So I'm going to be giving that as the main advice in this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 但如果你有特殊情况，那么，你知道，告诉我，或者谷歌一下。

sentences.en: But if you've got circumstances outside of this, then, you know, just let me know or yeah, give it a Google.
sentences.zh: 谷歌上可以找到很多信息。

sentences.en: There's a lot that can be found on Google.
sentences.zh: 我知道过去几年清算所一直有申请费，去年如果你在10月20日之前提交申请并付款，费用是30英镑。

sentences.en: So I'm aware that for the last few years, there has been a fee, an application fee for the clearinghouse and certainly of last year, if you submit your application and pay before
sentences.zh: 但如果你在10月21日到截止日期（去年是11月17日）之间提交申请，费用就是40英镑。

sentences.en: the 20th of October, the fee was £30.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为处理费，去年截止时间是17日下午1点。

sentences.en: But if you submit your application between the 21st of October and the deadline, which last year was the 17th of November, then the fee was £40.
sentences.zh: 但请务必核对2022年的日期，因为它们很可能不同。

sentences.en: And they call it a processing fee and the deadline time was 1pm on the 17th last year.
sentences.zh: 我的建议是，考虑一下你的选择和经历是否会在10月21日到11月17日之间发生变化。

sentences.en: But please do check the dates for 2022 because they may well be different.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你在等待新的工作录用通知，或者即将开始一份新工作，或者你在等待可以添加到传播部分的发表细节。

sentences.en: My advice would actually be consider whether your options and your experiences might be changing between the 21st of October and the 17th of November.
sentences.zh: 如果第一次截止时间和第二次之间可能会有变化，那么等待一段时间直到你能把这些内容写进表格可能对你更有利，

sentences.en: So if you're waiting for new job offer, perhaps, or to start a new job and there's something where
sentences.zh: 因为这可能有助于你获得更高的分数。

sentences.en: you're waiting on publication details that you might be able to add to your dissemination section.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，如果你确信自己反思得很好，你已经有了足够的经验，并且在表格上做得非常好，或者

sentences.en: If there's something that might change between that first deadline time and the second, that it's probably going to be in your interest to wait a little bit until you can put that
sentences.zh: 如果你申请的是只要符合标准就会被邀请参加选拔测试的课程，那么你就不那么关注表格的质量或内容，

sentences.en: on your form because that might help you to score more points.
sentences.zh: 你可能很想早点完成，这样它就能早点被审阅，但我认为你不会得到任何特殊待遇。

sentences.en: But largely speaking, if you're confident that you are reflecting well, you've, you know, you've got enough experience that you've done a really good job on your form, or for that
sentences.zh: 面试名额有限，你只会和大家在同一时间收到是否被邀请面试的通知，

sentences.en: matter, if you're applying for a course where you just get invited to a selection test, if you meet the criteria, and so you're not so focused on the quality or the content of your
sentences.zh: 那将是在春季，这是事件的一般顺序。

sentences.en: form, then you might well want to do it early so that it gets looked at early so that you get, you know, just, I don't think you get any special treatment.
sentences.zh: 所以通常在2月、3月左右，不同课程的日期会公布，而且是错开的。

sentences.en: There are only so many places available for interview, and you'll only get notified whether you've been invited for interview
sentences.zh: 面试日期是错开的。

sentences.en: at the same time, you know, as everybody else, which will be springtime, which is a general order of events.
sentences.zh: 通常在4月、5月、6月左右，但它们组织得很好，地理位置相近的课程不应该有太多的重叠。

sentences.en: So usually sort of February, March time dates come out for different courses, and they're staggered.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你申请的是全国不同地区的课程，你可能会在同一周收到邀请，这并不罕见，但通常会有一些灵活性。

sentences.en: The interview dates are staggered.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道他们是否会进行一点协作，以确保他们不会在同一天安排面试。

sentences.en: Usually, they're around April, May,
sentences.zh: 但如果你确实在同一天收到了面试邀请，我认为他们做出调整是绝对合理的，

sentences.en: June time, but they are quite well organised so that there shouldn't be too much overlap for courses that are geographically close.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果是面对面面试的话。

sentences.en: So it could well be that if you're applying for courses in different areas of the country, that you're getting invites in the same week, it's not unheard of, but there is
sentences.zh: 所以，是否应该等待是第一个问题。

sentences.en: usually some flexibility.
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的取决于你自己的情况。

sentences.en: I don't even know if they maybe do a little bit of collaboration to make sure they're not offering you on the same day.
sentences.zh: 有些人真的很喜欢夏天什么都不做，完全不碰心理学。

sentences.en: But if you were in a position where you did get offered on the same day, I think it would be absolutely reasonable that they, that they accommodate that
sentences.zh: 有些人可能在2022年申请季得知自己没有成功。

sentences.en: change, especially if it, if it is an in-person interview.
sentences.zh: 他们可能早在2月、3月就知道了。

sentences.en: So yeah, should you wait is question one.
sentences.zh: 所以从早春、冬末到9月1日秋季开始，这可能会让人感觉压力很大。

sentences.en: I think that really depends on your own circumstances.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能已经提前开始了，甚至已经写好了申请书。

sentences.en: And if you have been, some people really like the summer to just like do nothing, psychology at all.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能迫不及待，尤其是如果他们没有新的经历可以填在表格上的话。

sentences.en: Some people will have learned that they hadn't been successful during the 2022 season.
sentences.zh: 我知道我做助理心理学家时，新的机会和经历出现得很快，

sentences.en: They may have learned that in February, as early as February, March.
sentences.zh: 比如新提供给你的小组工作或新的研究机会。

sentences.en: And so it can feel like quite a weight from, from very early spring, late winter, to the very start of autumn on the 1st of September.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，我也在等工作录用通知。

sentences.en: So they might well have made a head start or perhaps even written their application already.
sentences.zh: 所以我能在表格上写明我将开始一份新工作，因为那时我也已经有了入职日期。

sentences.en: And so they may be eager and raring to go, especially if they haven't gotten new experiences to pop on their form.
sentences.zh: 所以当我的表格被审阅时，我已经开始了那份工作，因为我定于2月入职。

sentences.en: So I know when I was working as an assistant, it could be fairly quick changing, really, you know, in terms of the new opportunities
sentences.zh: 所以当我开始面试时，我已经在那岗位上工作了大约三个月了。

sentences.en: and experiences that come up, you know, new groups that get offered to you to run or new research opportunities.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，这将取决于你独特的因素。

sentences.en: So for me, I was also waiting on a job offer.
sentences.zh: 你可以决定，你可以选择。

sentences.en: So I was able to put on my form that I was going to be starting a new job because I had a job start date then as well.
sentences.zh: 没有对错之分，但与你的主管、临床督导讨论这些问题会非常有用。

sentences.en: So by the time my form was reviewed, I had actually started that job because I was due to start in the February.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你已经由合格的临床心理学家进行督导，获得一点视角和洞察力是很好的。

sentences.en: So by the time I started, by the time I did my interviews, I'd already been working in that post for three-ish months.
sentences.zh: 在提交申请表之前，找一位合格的专业人士以及一位与心理学无关的人阅读你的申请表也是一个非常好的主意。

sentences.en: So yeah, it will be dependent on your unique factors.
sentences.zh: 因为我们想确保我们没有使用行话。

sentences.en: You get to decide, you get to choose.
sentences.zh: 我在筛选表格、查看他人的表格，甚至阅读和编辑即将出版的《有抱负的心理学家》书籍的文稿时，

sentences.en: There's no right or wrong answer, but it can be really useful to discuss that with your supervisor, your clinical supervisor.
sentences.zh: 我们确实会大量使用行话，因为我们太习惯于知道它的含义，或者只是使用缩写，

sentences.en: Certainly if you are already being supervised by a qualified clinical psychologist to get a little bit of perspective, a little bit of insight.
sentences.zh: 这些缩写在我的特定领域或专业中可能意味着不同的东西，而在你那里可能意味着别的。
